item.description: Introduction: Black holes are some of the most mysterious and fascinating objects in the universe. item.title: What are White Holes, and What Would Discovering Them Mean?
item.description: What is a White Hole?: White holes are a theoretical concept in physics, which are the hypothetical time-reversed counterparts of black holes. Black holes are known for their intense gravitational pull, and anything that crosses the point of no return, known as the event horizon, will be sucked in and can never escape.
